description: Resets the funnel numbers of one webinar, for example after test registrations have polluted them. Take it when the figures no longer tell the truth: "I registered ten times myself, wipe that out." It needs the session, the webinar, which of two scopes you mean and a clear yes from you. One scope reopens only the current show window, the other wipes all daily and touch statistics of this webinar. Say which one it is and what is lost before anything happens. Registrants, emails and the campaign itself are not touched, and the numbers cannot be restored. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: reset numbers, funnel stats, wrong numbers, test registrations, clear statistics

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that these numbers may be reset.

scope.description: window reopens the current show window, lifetime wipes all statistics of this webinar.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_reset_webinar_funnel
title: Reset the funnel numbers of a webinar
